Elias, who had kept the light for thirty-one years, found it while gathering driftwood for his stove. Inside was a strip of oilskin, folded around a child’s drawing of a yellow house. The message read: “If anyone finds this, tell my father the waves brought us safely home.” There was no name, only a date forty years earlier. Elias remembered that winter: the wreck, the empty lifeboat, the father who had waited on the cliffs until spring. He climbed to the lamp room and watched the horizon brighten. Then he wrapped the drawing again, added his own note—“He waited, and he never stopped loving you”—and returned the bottle to the tide.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台调低音量的机器。高架桥上灯影稀疏，出租车划过湿漉漉的路面，把霓虹拖成细长的红线。便利店的白光落在空货架上，夜班店员靠着柜台打盹。清洁工推车的声音从街角慢慢靠近，早餐铺升起第一笼蒸汽。居民楼的窗大多暗着，只有一间厨房亮着暖黄的灯。风穿过行道树，天色仍深，城市却在无人注意的地方，悄悄准备醒来。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box and finding another box inside; you repeat the same opening steps until you reach a box with a prize.\n- Every recursive solution needs a stopping point, so it knows when to stop instead of continuing forever."}
